workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Validates the priced order, reserves inventory, walks a ladder of increasingly desperate payment processors (the last rung always approves), dispatches the order and confirms it. Uses system tasks only, so no worker has to be running, and falls back to chaos_checkout_rescue on any failure: checkout always completes.
